notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No Steam app, so no achievement list (see the collectibles note). No StrategyWiki page under "Alan Wake 2" or "Alan Wake II". alanwake.fandom.com answers the API with about 76 linked articles, including "Prologue: The Cult", "Return 1: Invitation" to "Return 9: Come Home", "Initiation 1: Late Night" to "Initiation 9: Gone", "The Final Draft", "Expansion 1: Night Springs", "Expansion 2: The Lake House" and "Return Addendum: The Lake House"; the chapters use those page names only, nothing copied. The data does not give the play order between the Return and Initiation chapters, so they are grouped by name, not by when you play them. RAWG lists Night Springs (2024-06-08) and The Lake House (2024-10-22) as their own entries. RAWG has no playtime yet.
